title.narrative: Promoting Resilience of Conflict Affected Populations in the BAY States through integrated CP and GBV Interventions

description.narrative: ltpgtChild protection and Peer Learning Initiative and El-Kanami Memorial Foundation possess an experienced core team with a variety of experiences in GBV, child protection, psychosocial support, and project management. This project is design to support crisis affected children and their families as well as women and girls survivors of gender-based violence and other vulnerable individual at risks through promoting their resilience and enhancing positive coping mechanisms. The project is a multi-sectoral intervention focusing on integrated CP and GBV response will geographically be implemented in Madagali LGA in Adamawa and Dikwa LGA in Borno state. ltbrgtCPPLI is requesting a total of $100,000 ($75,000 from the CP AoR $25,000 from the GBV AoR) to implement this project across 2 LGAs mentioned above. The project will directly reach a total of 5210 individuals with comprehensive CP GBV response services that meets inter agency guidelines. Of these total numbers, 15% (799) are persons with disabilities, and 15630 individuals are indirectly targeted. In terms of sector specific target: 3030 individuals are targeted under CP AoR while 2180 are targeted under GBV. This targeting is strategic and had aligned closely with the priorities of both the GBV CP AoRs. This project aims to achieve 4 outcomes that surrounded CP GBV service provision. ltbrgtOutcome 1 is a child protection outcome which aimed at ensuring that unaccompanied and separated children, including children who have suffered grave child rights violations such as CAAGs and other Children at risk of abuse, neglect, exploitation and violence including children with disabilities affected by humanitarian conflict accessed comprehensive case management services and enjoy adequate protection of their rights. ltbrgtOutcome 2 is also a child protection outcome which focused to ensured that conflict affected children and their caregivers and other members of the communities accessed quality mental health and psycho-social support and adopted positive behaviors and social norms that aimed at eliminating abuse, neglect, exploitation and violence against boys and girls.ltbrgtOutcome 3 of the project focused on both CP and GBV institutional systems strengthening at both government and community levels through enhancing the government capacities and other protection actors including community based systems to be able to respond adequately to child protection and gender-based violence related issues through prevention, risk mitigation and response services that align with relevant standards. ltbrgtOutcome 4 is a gender-based violence outcome which focused to ensure that survivors of GBV and other vulnerable individual at risks have improved access to quality lifesaving and well-coordinated GBV response services and have their wellbeing enhanced ltbrgtlt/pgt
